arStrings.szText: While you have {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c}, all incoming Direct Damage is converted into Shadow Damage and has a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to steal {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} from your attacker.
